ego.name: Egocentric human
ego.blurb: First-person capture of people doing things — the largest and cheapest source of manipulation data.

exo.name: Third-person video
exo.blurb: Exocentric human video: abundant, noisy, and the hardest viewpoint to transfer from.

umi.name: UMI & handheld
umi.blurb: Robot-free capture rigs that produce directly deployable demonstrations.

teleop.name: Teleoperation
teleop.blurb: Demonstrations collected by a human driving the robot, through leader-follower, VR or exoskeleton.

robot.name: Robot manipulation at scale
robot.blurb: Large pooled corpora of real robot trajectories, single- and cross-embodiment.

dex.name: Hand-object & dexterous
dex.blurb: Fine-grained hand pose, contact and grasping — human and synthetic.

tactile.name: Tactile
tactile.blurb: Touch data, paired with vision and language where it exists.

hri.name: Human-robot interaction
hri.blurb: Robots perceiving, navigating around, and physically exchanging objects with people.

multi.name: Multi-robot & collaboration
multi.blurb: Two or more agents coordinating on a shared task. The thinnest category here, which is itself the finding.

motion.name: Human motion & humanoid
motion.blurb: Mocap and pose corpora that humanoid whole-body controllers are trained on.

sim.name: Simulation benchmarks
sim.blurb: Task suites that define what progress is measured against.

datasets.name: Egocentric-1M
datasets.title: Egocentric-1M
datasets.one: Roughly one million hours of factory-floor egocentric video — larger than every prior egocentric dataset combined, released open under Apache 2.0.
datasets.note: Build AI's scaling ladder went 10K hours (Nov 2025) → 100K (Dec 2025) → 1M (Apr 2026). The framing to hold onto: this is industrial repetitive labour, not household diversity, so it is enormous and narrow at the same time. Whether that narrowness matters is an open empirical question and a very cheap one to test.

datasets.name: HumanNet
datasets.title: HumanNet: Scaling Human-centric Video Learning to One Million Hours
datasets.one: A human-centric video learning stack built to scale to one million hours, with controlled VLA ablations on the value of the data.
datasets.note: Read it for the ablation rather than the corpus: it is one of the few papers that isolates what an extra order of magnitude of human video actually buys a VLA. Caveat: the million-hour figure is the paper's stated scale — its controlled ablations run at far smaller sizes, so treat the headline as a design target rather than a corpus you can download today.

datasets.name: Egocentric-100K
datasets.title: Egocentric-100K
datasets.one: The 100,000-hour rung of Build AI's ladder — the release that made million-hour egocentric look inevitable.

datasets.name: EgoScale
datasets.title: EgoScale: Scaling Dexterous Manipulation with Diverse Egocentric Human Data
datasets.one: NVIDIA GEAR's scaling study: a VLA trained on 20,854 hours of action-labelled egocentric human video, with a measured log-linear scaling law.
datasets.modal: RGB, wrist motion, retargeted dexterous hand actions
datasets.note: The most important number in this table for your ego-dexterity idea: validation loss falls log-linearly with human data scale, and that loss correlates with real-robot performance. It turns 'more human video helps' from a hope into a predictable curve.

datasets.name: Ego2Robot
datasets.title: Ego2Robot: Scalable Robot Data Synthesis from Egocentric Human Data
datasets.one: A pipeline that converts egocentric human video into robot training data, producing 18,561 hours across 15 robot morphologies — the largest ego-to-robot corpus to date.
datasets.note: The other half of the million-hour story: raw human hours are useless until something turns them into actions. Action retargeting + robot-arm visual synthesis + multi-level quality curation is the recipe.

datasets.name: Xperience-10M
datasets.title: Xperience-10M
datasets.one: Ten thousand hours of egocentric recording with six synchronised RGB streams, stereo depth, SLAM pose and full hand-plus-body motion capture — roughly a petabyte.
datasets.modal: 6× RGB, audio, stereo depth, camera pose/SLAM, hand mocap, full-body mocap, IMU, hierarchical language
datasets.note: The richest egocentric annotation stack that exists — depth, SLAM and mocap all synchronised. Where Egocentric-1M has scale and nothing else, this has everything a real-to-sim or retargeting pipeline needs. If you only adopt one corpus for the Real2Sim2Real project, it is probably this one.

datasets.name: Egocentric-10K
datasets.title: Egocentric-10K
datasets.one: The first rung: 10,000 hours of factory egocentric video, November 2025.

datasets.name: ACE-Ego-0
datasets.title: ACE-Ego-0: Unifying Egocentric Human and Robotic Data for VLA Pretraining
datasets.one: A VLA pretraining framework that mixes robot, simulation and pseudo-action-labelled egocentric human data in one recipe.
datasets.note: The mixing ratio between robot, sim and human data is the real content here — the question everyone training a VLA has to answer and almost nobody reports.

datasets.name: Ego4D
datasets.title: Ego4D: Around the World in 3,000 Hours of Egocentric Video
datasets.one: The foundational egocentric corpus: daily-life video from 931 wearers in 9 countries, with benchmark suites for memory, forecasting and social understanding.
datasets.device: Head-mounted cameras (Vuzix, GoPro, Aria, Weeview, Pupil)
datasets.modal: RGB, audio, 3D scans, eye gaze, IMU, stereo (subset)
datasets.note: The substrate under almost every 'learn from human video' result. No native hand-pose labels — that gap is why EgoDex and OpenEgo exist.

datasets.name: EgoVerse
datasets.title: EgoVerse: An Egocentric Human Dataset for Robot Learning from Around the World
datasets.one: A collaborative, standardised egocentric platform pooling human demonstrations from labs and industry worldwide.
datasets.note: The largest single egocentric manipulation release, and the first serious attempt at a shared contribution standard rather than another siloed corpus.

datasets.name: Ego-Exo4D
datasets.title: Ego-Exo4D: Understanding Skilled Human Activity from First- and Third-Person Perspectives
datasets.one: Time-synchronised first- and third-person video of the same skilled activity — the dataset that turns 'is ego better than exo?' into an experiment.
datasets.modal: RGB, multi-view, audio, eye gaze, IMU, 3D pose, expert commentary
datasets.note: The only large corpus with genuinely paired ego/exo views. Central to the third-person-learning idea.

datasets.name: OpenEgo
datasets.title: OpenEgo: A Large-Scale Multimodal Egocentric Dataset for Dexterous Manipulation
datasets.one: Six public egocentric datasets unified into one schema with hand-pose and manipulation annotations.
datasets.note: Aggregation, not new capture — but the harmonised schema saves weeks of data engineering.

datasets.name: EgoDex
datasets.title: EgoDex: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Large-Scale Egocentric Video
datasets.one: Apple's large-scale egocentric video with paired 3D hand and finger tracking captured at record time, aimed squarely at dexterous manipulation.
datasets.modal: RGB 1080p/30 Hz, 3D hand + finger pose, camera pose
datasets.note: Solves Ego4D's biggest gap — native, accurate hand pose at scale. The most useful single corpus for the ego-dexterity idea.

datasets.name: Nymeria
datasets.title: Nymeria: A Massive Collection of Multimodal Egocentric Daily Motion in the Wild
datasets.one: Egocentric daily motion in the wild with full-body ground truth — the largest paired ego-video-plus-motion-capture collection.
datasets.device: Project Aria glasses + wrist Aria + XSens body suit
datasets.modal: RGB, SLAM, eye gaze, IMU, full-body 3D motion, language narration
datasets.note: The body-motion counterpart to Ego4D. If you want humanoid whole-body targets from ego video, this is the supervision.

datasets.name: EgoExoLearn
datasets.title: EgoExoLearn: A Dataset for Bridging Asynchronous Ego- and Exo-centric View of Procedural Activities in Real World
datasets.one: Asynchronous ego and exo video of the same procedures — humans watching a demonstration and then doing the task themselves.
datasets.note: Asynchronous rather than simultaneous ego/exo — closer to how a robot would actually learn by watching.

datasets.name: Rescaling Egocentric Vision
datasets.title: Rescaling Egocentric Vision
datasets.one: Long-term unscripted kitchen activity from head-mounted cameras, densely annotated with fine-grained actions.
datasets.note: The precision standard for egocentric action annotation; small next to Ego4D but far more densely labelled.

datasets.name: EPIC Fields
datasets.title: EPIC Fields: Marrying 3D Geometry and Video Understanding
datasets.one: EPIC-KITCHENS re-registered in 3D — camera poses and neural-rendering-ready reconstructions for 96% of its videos.
datasets.note: Directly relevant to real-to-sim: it is egocentric video already solved for geometry.

datasets.name: HOT3D
datasets.title: HOT3D: Hand and Object Tracking in 3D from Egocentric Multi-View Videos
datasets.one: Egocentric multi-view hand and object tracking in 3D, with laser-scanned object models and ground-truth poses.
datasets.modal: RGB, monochrome, 3D hand pose, object 6D pose, eye gaze
datasets.note: The precision benchmark for egocentric hand-object tracking — use it to validate your pose pipeline before trusting it on Ego4D.

datasets.name: EgoEMG
datasets.title: EgoEMG: A Multimodal Egocentric Dataset with Bilateral EMG and Vision for Hand Pose Estimation
datasets.one: Egocentric video paired with bilateral wrist EMG — muscle activity as a modality vision cannot see.
datasets.device: 2× 8-channel wrist EMG @2 kHz, IMU, ego RGB, external RGB-D, mocap
datasets.modal: EMG, IMU, RGB, RGB-D, hand mocap
datasets.note: Unusual and under-explored: EMG carries intent and force before motion is visible, which is exactly the gap a vision-only world model has.

datasets.name: HumanEgo
datasets.title: HumanEgo: Zero-Shot Robot Learning from Minutes of Human Egocentric Videos
datasets.one: The opposite bet from scaling: zero-shot robot learning from as little as 30 minutes of human egocentric video per task.
datasets.note: 92.5% success from 30 minutes of human video, beating matched-time robot teleoperation by 41%. The sharpest counterpoint in this whole table to the million-hour thesis — worth taking seriously before you commit to a collection campaign.

datasets.name: EgoKit
datasets.title: EgoKit: Towards Unified Low-Cost Egocentric Data Collection with Heterogeneous Devices
datasets.one: An open, low-cost toolkit for collecting egocentric data across heterogeneous devices, including XR headsets with 26-joint hand tracking.
datasets.modal: RGB, head pose, OpenXR 26-joint hand tracking
datasets.note: If you want to run your own egocentric collection rather than consume someone else's, this is the cheapest credible starting point.

datasets.name: EgoLive
datasets.title: EgoLive: A Large-Scale Egocentric Dataset from Real-World Human Tasks
datasets.one: Large-scale egocentric capture from real-world human tasks, positioned on breadth of semantic coverage rather than raw hours.
datasets.note: Argues that the long tail of semantics matters more than hour count, and benchmarks itself against EgoDex and Xperience-10M on exactly that. Worth reading as the counter-argument to pure scaling.

datasets.name: Ego-Exo 3D Hand Tracking in the Wild with a Mobile Multi-Camera Rig
datasets.title: Ego-Exo 3D Hand Tracking in the Wild with a Mobile Multi-Camera Rig
datasets.one: In-the-wild 3D hand tracking from a mobile multi-camera ego-exo rig, built to get ground truth outside the lab.

datasets.name: EgoVLA
datasets.title: EgoVLA: Learning Vision-Language-Action Models from Egocentric Human Videos
datasets.one: Not a dataset but the reference recipe: train a VLA on egocentric human video, then transfer it to a robot.
datasets.note: Read alongside the ego datasets — it tells you what preprocessing they actually need to be usable.

datasets.name: H-RDT
datasets.title: H-RDT: Human Manipulation Enhanced Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
datasets.one: Bimanual manipulation improved by pretraining on large-scale egocentric human video with paired 3D hand poses.

datasets.name: Aria Everyday Activities Dataset
datasets.title: Aria Everyday Activities Dataset
datasets.one: Everyday activity sequences from Aria glasses with globally aligned 3D trajectories, gaze and speech.
datasets.modal: RGB, SLAM, eye gaze, point cloud, speech transcript
datasets.note: Small but the cleanest machine-perception annotations of the Aria family.

datasets.name: EgoVid-5M
datasets.title: EgoVid-5M: A Large-Scale Video-Action Dataset for Egocentric Video Generation
datasets.one: Five million egocentric clips curated specifically for training egocentric video generation with action conditioning.
datasets.note: If you want to train a world model on the ego stream, this is the pre-curated pretraining set.

datasets.name: Project Aria
datasets.title: Project Aria: A New Tool for Egocentric Multi-Modal AI Research
datasets.one: The glasses themselves: the research platform and open tooling that most modern egocentric datasets are recorded on.
datasets.modal: RGB, SLAM cameras, eye tracking, IMU, magnetometer, barometer, audio
datasets.note: Not a dataset — the capture platform. Worth knowing the sensor suite before designing your own rig.

datasets.name: HOI4D
datasets.title: HOI4D: A 4D Egocentric Dataset for Category-Level Human-Object Interaction
datasets.one: 4D egocentric human-object interaction with per-frame panoptic segmentation, object poses and hand poses.
datasets.modal: RGB-D, 3D hand pose, object 6D pose, panoptic masks
datasets.note: Very dense annotation, very few subjects — the opposite tradeoff from Ego4D.

datasets.name: EgoBody
datasets.title: EgoBody: Human Body Shape and Motion of Interacting People from Head-Mounted Devices
datasets.one: Egocentric recordings of two-person social interaction with accurate 3D body shape and motion for the interactee.
datasets.modal: RGB-D, SMPL-X body meshes, eye gaze, scene mesh
datasets.note: The human-partner perception data an HRI system needs, from the wearer's viewpoint.

datasets.name: H2O
datasets.title: H2O: Two Hands Manipulating Objects for First Person Interaction Recognition
datasets.one: Two hands manipulating objects from a first-person view, with markerless 3D annotations for both hands and object 6D pose.
datasets.modal: RGB-D, two-hand 3D pose, object 6D pose, interaction labels

datasets.name: YUBI
datasets.title: YUBI: Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation at Scale
datasets.one: Bidigital handheld interface for bimanual dexterity, with a UMI-style dataset of genuinely unprecedented scale.
datasets.note: 8,434 hours from a handheld interface — an order of magnitude past anything teleoperated. This is the strongest existing evidence for the UMI-scaling thesis.

datasets.name: Open-AoE
datasets.title: Open-AoE: An Open Egocentric Manipulation Dataset and Toolchain for Embodied Learning
datasets.one: An open egocentric manipulation dataset shipped with its capture toolchain rather than as a frozen release.
datasets.note: The toolchain is the valuable half — it means you can extend it rather than only consume it.

datasets.name: RealDexUMI
datasets.title: RealDexUMI: A Wearable Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Robot Learning
datasets.one: A wearable universal manipulation interface built specifically for dexterous robot learning.

datasets.name: Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton
datasets.title: Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton: Learning Compliant Whole-body Policies with Real-time Torque Feedback
datasets.one: Whole-body exoskeleton capture with compliance — the force dimension UMI-style rigs leave out.
datasets.modal: RGB, joint state, contact force, whole-body pose

datasets.name: DexUMI
datasets.title: DexUMI: Using Human Hand as the Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Manipulation
datasets.one: Dexterous-hand demonstrations captured with a wearable exoskeleton adapter plus video inpainting of the robot hand.
datasets.note: The two-part gap-closing recipe — hardware for kinematics, inpainting for appearance.

datasets.name: FastUMI-100K
datasets.title: FastUMI-100K: Advancing Data-driven Robotic Manipulation with a Large-scale UMI-style Dataset
datasets.one: The largest open UMI-style corpus: 100K+ handheld demonstrations in household environments, released in LeRobot format.
datasets.modal: RGB multi-view wrist fisheye, EE state, text annotations
datasets.note: LeRobot v2.1 formatted, so it drops straight into an existing training stack. The obvious starting corpus for a UMI world model.

datasets.name: Universal Manipulation Interface
datasets.title: Universal Manipulation Interface: In-The-Wild Robot Teaching Without In-The-Wild Robots
datasets.one: The original handheld-gripper demonstrations: deployable robot data collected in the wild with no robot present.
datasets.device: UMI handheld gripper + fisheye GoPro + side mirrors
datasets.modal: RGB fisheye, 6-DoF EE pose (SLAM), gripper width
datasets.note: Small by modern standards, but it defined the format everything below follows.

datasets.name: RoboTurk
datasets.title: RoboTurk: A Crowdsourcing Platform for Robotic Skill Learning through Imitation
datasets.one: Crowdsourced 6-DoF teleoperation through ordinary phones — the first attempt to scale demonstration collection past a single lab.
datasets.note: Historically important: the argument that operator access, not robot count, is the bottleneck.

datasets.name: AirExo-2
datasets.title: AirExo-2: Scaling up Generalizable Robotic Imitation Learning with Low-Cost Exoskeletons
datasets.one: In-the-wild demonstrations from a low-cost exoskeleton, designed to transfer without robot data.
datasets.note: The main competitor framing for UME-style exoskeleton capture.

datasets.name: DexCap
datasets.title: DexCap: Scalable and Portable Mocap Data Collection System for Dexterous Manipulation
datasets.one: Portable glove-plus-SLAM mocap for dexterous manipulation, collected without a robot in the loop.
datasets.device: Rokoko glove + LiDAR chest rig + SLAM
datasets.modal: RGB-D, finger joint angles, 6-DoF wrist pose, point cloud
datasets.note: The most direct hardware precedent for a world-action model from glove capture.

datasets.name: HumanPlus
datasets.title: HumanPlus: Humanoid Shadowing and Imitation from Humans
datasets.one: Humanoid shadowing from a single RGB camera, plus the imitation data it produces on a 33-DoF humanoid.
datasets.device: single RGB camera (shadowing) + 40 h of human mocap
datasets.tasks: wearing shoes, warehouse unloading, folding, typing

datasets.name: Mobile ALOHA
datasets.title: Mobile ALOHA: Learning Bimanual Mobile Manipulation with Low-Cost Whole-Body Teleoperation
datasets.one: Mobile bimanual demonstrations with whole-body teleoperation, plus the co-training result that static data lifts mobile performance.
datasets.note: The co-training finding — up to 90% improvement from static data — is the reusable result, not the dataset.

datasets.name: Open-TeleVision
datasets.title: Open-TeleVision: Teleoperation with Immersive Active Visual Feedback
datasets.one: Open-source immersive VR teleoperation with active stereo vision — cheap, high-quality bimanual demonstrations.
datasets.modal: stereo RGB, hand/arm pose, robot state

datasets.name: Learning Fine-Grained Bimanual Manipulation with Low-Cost Hardware
datasets.title: Learning Fine-Grained Bimanual Manipulation with Low-Cost Hardware
datasets.one: Fine-grained bimanual demonstrations from the low-cost leader-follower rig that made bimanual IL reproducible.
datasets.note: Tiny, and that is the point — 50 demos per task was enough for threading a zip tie.

datasets.name: Qwen-RobotManip Technical Report
datasets.title: Qwen-RobotManip Technical Report: Alignment Unlocks Scale for Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models
datasets.one: A ~38,100-hour pretraining corpus assembled entirely from open datasets and human video, with a human-to-robot synthesis pipeline across 15 platforms.
datasets.device: aggregated open data + egocentric human video
datasets.note: Notable for using no proprietary collection at all — a direct test of whether open data plus human video is enough.

datasets.name: Galaxea Open-World Dataset and G0 Dual-System VLA Model
datasets.title: Galaxea Open-World Dataset and G0 Dual-System VLA Model
datasets.one: 500+ hours of mobile manipulation in real homes and workplaces, all on one embodiment.
datasets.device: Galaxea R1-Lite mobile bimanual robot, teleoperation
datasets.note: Authentic living and working environments rather than lab mock-ups — closest in spirit to what MABEL would need.

datasets.name: DROID
datasets.title: DROID: A Large-Scale In-The-Wild Robot Manipulation Dataset
datasets.one: In-the-wild manipulation collected on one standardised hardware setup across 564 scenes — diversity with consistency.
datasets.device: Franka Panda + Robotiq, VR teleoperation, 3 cameras (2 stereo + wrist)
datasets.modal: RGB stereo, depth, proprioception, language, camera calibration
datasets.note: Standardised hardware is why it is more useful per-episode than OXE. The stereo calibration makes it usable for 3D policies.

datasets.name: AgiBot World 2026
datasets.title: AgiBot World 2026
datasets.one: AgiBot's 2026 release, aimed at reinforcement learning rather than imitation: real-world trajectories across industrial and household tasks.
datasets.note: Small next to the original million-trajectory AgiBot World, and deliberately so — it is structured for RL, which almost no large robot dataset is. Released with Shanghai AI Lab and the National-Local Humanoid Robotics Innovation Centre.

datasets.name: AgiBot World Colosseo
datasets.title: AgiBot World Colosseo: A Large-scale Manipulation Platform for Scalable and Intelligent Embodied Systems
datasets.one: A million-plus trajectories from a fleet of 100+ identical humanoid mobile manipulators — uniformity as the design principle.
datasets.note: The industrial answer to DROID: hardware uniformity instead of institutional diversity. Which bet is right is still open.

datasets.name: RoboCOIN
datasets.title: RoboCOIN: An Open-Sourced Bimanual Robotic Data Collection for Integrated Manipulation
datasets.one: Large-scale bimanual manipulation across 15 robot platforms, categorised by the type of two-arm coordination required.
datasets.note: The taxonomy of 39 bimanual coordination actions is genuinely useful — it is the closest thing to a vocabulary for two-arm collaboration.

datasets.name: All Robots in One
datasets.title: All Robots in One: A New Standard and Unified Dataset for Versatile, General-Purpose Embodied Agents
datasets.one: A unified standard plus the largest aggregated embodied dataset — roughly 3 million episodes across 258 series.
datasets.note: Enormous, and the data-format standard is the more durable contribution.

datasets.name: FMB
datasets.title: FMB: a Functional Manipulation Benchmark for Generalizable Robotic Learning
datasets.one: A functional manipulation benchmark built from 3D-printed objects so other labs can replicate the physical setup exactly.
datasets.note: Reproducible physical hardware is rare and underrated — this is one of the few real-robot benchmarks you can actually rebuild.

datasets.name: RoboMIND
datasets.title: RoboMIND: Benchmark on Multi-embodiment Intelligence Normative Data for Robot Manipulation
datasets.one: Multi-embodiment manipulation collected under a single standardised protocol, spanning single-arm, dual-arm and humanoid.
datasets.note: The standardised protocol is the contribution; most pooled datasets are heterogeneous messes by comparison.

datasets.name: BridgeData V2
datasets.title: BridgeData V2: A Dataset for Robot Learning at Scale
datasets.one: Diverse low-cost-arm manipulation designed for studying generalisation, on hardware any lab can buy.
datasets.note: The generalisation benchmark of the pre-DROID era, and still the cheapest to reproduce.

datasets.name: Open X-Embodiment
datasets.title: Open X-Embodiment: Robotic Learning Datasets and RT-X Models
datasets.one: The pooled cross-embodiment corpus: 22 robot types from 21 institutions in one schema — the ImageNet moment for robot data.
datasets.note: The training set under Octo, OpenVLA and most open generalist policies. Heterogeneous to a fault — the per-dataset quality varies enormously.

datasets.name: RH20T
datasets.title: RH20T: A Comprehensive Robotic Dataset for Learning Diverse Skills in One-Shot
datasets.one: Contact-rich manipulation at scale with force-torque, across many skills, robots and viewpoints — the most under-used corpus in this table.
datasets.modal: RGB-D multi-view, force-torque, tactile, audio, proprioception
datasets.note: One of very few large datasets with real force-torque throughout. If you care about contact-rich learning, this is the corpus to start from.

datasets.name: RoboAgent
datasets.title: RoboAgent: Generalization and Efficiency in Robot Manipulation via Semantic Augmentations and Action Chunking
datasets.one: A sample-efficiency demonstration: 12 skills and 38 tasks from only 7,500 demonstrations via semantic augmentation.

datasets.name: BC-Z
datasets.title: BC-Z: Zero-Shot Task Generalization with Robotic Imitation Learning
datasets.one: Robot demonstrations paired with human videos and language, built for zero-shot task generalisation.

datasets.name: Interactive Language
datasets.title: Interactive Language: Talking to Robots in Real Time
datasets.one: Nearly 600K language-labelled trajectories for real-time language-conditioned control on a tabletop.
datasets.note: An order of magnitude more language labels than anything before it.

datasets.name: RT-1
datasets.title: RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale
datasets.one: Google's 17-month kitchen-scale collection — the dataset that first showed robot policies follow a data-scaling curve.
datasets.note: Not fully open, but the scaling result is the reason everything after it exists.

datasets.name: RoboNet
datasets.title: RoboNet: Large-Scale Multi-Robot Learning
datasets.one: The first serious multi-robot pooled dataset — video of many robots interacting with objects, shared across institutions.
datasets.note: The intellectual ancestor of Open X-Embodiment, five years early.

datasets.name: DexGraspNet 2.0
datasets.title: DexGraspNet 2.0: Learning Generative Dexterous Grasping in Large-scale Synthetic Cluttered Scenes
datasets.one: Dexterous grasping in cluttered scenes at scale — 427 million grasps with demonstrated zero-shot sim-to-real.
datasets.note: Reports 90.7% real-world success in clutter from synthetic data alone — a strong data point for the soft/sim2real debate.

datasets.name: OAKINK2
datasets.title: OAKINK2: A Dataset of Bimanual Hands-Object Manipulation in Complex Task Completion
datasets.one: Bimanual hand-object manipulation for complex multi-step daily tasks, organised into affordance / primitive / complex task levels.
datasets.note: The task-hierarchy abstraction is unusual and useful if you want long-horizon structure rather than single grasps.

datasets.name: TACO
datasets.title: TACO: Benchmarking Generalizable Bimanual Tool-ACtion-Object Understanding
datasets.one: Bimanual tool-action-object interaction with paired third-person and egocentric views.
datasets.modal: RGB, ego+exo, 3D hand-object meshes, action labels
datasets.note: Tool use specifically — the task family where functional correspondence matters most.

datasets.name: DexArt
datasets.title: DexArt: Benchmarking Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation with Articulated Objects
datasets.one: Benchmark for dexterous manipulation of articulated objects with generalisation to unseen instances.

datasets.name: ARCTIC
datasets.title: ARCTIC: A Dataset for Dexterous Bimanual Hand-Object Manipulation
datasets.one: Two hands dexterously manipulating articulated objects, with synchronised 3D meshes and dense contact annotation.
datasets.note: The contact annotation is the part that matters — it is what contact-consistent retargeting needs as supervision.

datasets.name: DexGraspNet
datasets.title: DexGraspNet: A Large-Scale Robotic Dexterous Grasp Dataset for General Objects Based on Simulation
datasets.one: A million-plus simulated ShadowHand grasps across thousands of objects, all validated in physics.
datasets.note: Synthetic, but the validation-in-physics step is what makes it usable rather than decorative.

datasets.name: DexYCB
datasets.title: DexYCB: A Benchmark for Capturing Hand Grasping of Objects
datasets.one: The standard benchmark for capturing human hand grasping of YCB objects, with 6D object and 3D hand pose.
datasets.note: NVIDIA. Small and clean; still the default evaluation set for hand-pose and handover work.

datasets.name: GRAB
datasets.title: GRAB: A Dataset of Whole-Body Human Grasping of Objects
datasets.one: Whole-body human grasping — not just hands, but the full body approaching and manipulating objects.
datasets.modal: SMPL-X whole-body, hand pose, contact, object pose
datasets.note: Whole-body context for grasping — relevant once your manipulator is attached to a mobile base rather than a table.

datasets.name: RoboTacDex
datasets.title: RoboTacDex: A Dexterous Visual-Tactile-Action Dataset for Humanoid Manipulation
datasets.one: Paired visual-tactile action data for humanoid dexterous manipulation.
datasets.note: Exactly the paired modality a tactile world model needs for pretraining.

datasets.name: A Touch, Vision, and Language Dataset for Multimodal Alignment
datasets.title: A Touch, Vision, and Language Dataset for Multimodal Alignment
datasets.one: In-the-wild vision-touch pairs with language labels — the dataset behind touch-vision-language alignment.
datasets.note: 90% of labels are GPT-4V pseudo-labels — useful, but know what you are training on.

datasets.name: Sparsh
datasets.title: Sparsh: Self-supervised touch representations for vision-based tactile sensing
datasets.one: Self-supervised touch representations plus TacBench — the closest thing tactile sensing has to a foundation model.
datasets.note: Meta. Reports large gains over task-specific training — the tactile analogue of R3M, and the encoder to start from for a tactile world model.

datasets.name: Towards Comprehensive Multimodal Perception
datasets.title: Towards Comprehensive Multimodal Perception: Introducing the Touch-Language-Vision Dataset
datasets.one: A touch-language-vision dataset with human-annotated tactile descriptions for semantic alignment.

datasets.name: The ObjectFolder Benchmark
datasets.title: The ObjectFolder Benchmark: Multisensory Learning with Neural and Real Objects
datasets.one: The real-world counterpart: measured vision, sound and touch for 100 physical household objects, with a 10-task benchmark.
datasets.device: scanning rig + GelSight + impact sound capture
datasets.note: The sim-and-real pairing is what makes this useful for multisensory sim-to-real.

datasets.name: ObjectFolder 2.0
datasets.title: ObjectFolder 2.0: A Multisensory Object Dataset for Sim2Real Transfer
datasets.one: Virtualised objects with visual, acoustic and tactile neural representations, built for sim-to-real transfer.

datasets.name: Touch and Go
datasets.title: Touch and Go: Learning from Human-Collected Vision and Touch
datasets.one: Human-collected paired vision and touch in the wild — someone walking around probing objects with a tactile sensor.
datasets.note: In-the-wild rather than lab-bench tactile data, which is rare and what pretraining needs.

datasets.name: Toward Human-Like Social Robot Navigation
datasets.title: Toward Human-Like Social Robot Navigation: A Large-Scale, Multi-Modal, Social Human Navigation Dataset
datasets.one: Multi-modal recordings of human navigation behaviour, captured to teach robots to move like people do.

datasets.name: Socially Compliant Navigation Dataset (SCAND)
datasets.title: Socially Compliant Navigation Dataset (SCAND): A Large-Scale Dataset of Demonstrations for Social Navigation
datasets.one: Socially compliant navigation demonstrations — humans teleoperating robots through real crowds.
datasets.modal: 3D lidar, RGB, joystick commands, odometry, IMU

datasets.name: THÖR-MAGNI
datasets.title: THÖR-MAGNI: A Large-scale Indoor Motion Capture Recording of Human Movement and Robot Interaction
datasets.one: Large-scale indoor motion capture of humans moving and interacting with robots in a shared workspace.
datasets.modal: 6-DoF human trajectories, robot trajectories, gaze, video
datasets.note: One of very few datasets with millimetre-accurate ground truth for both the human and the robot — the right substrate for measuring who adapts to whom.

datasets.name: JRDB
datasets.title: JRDB: A Dataset and Benchmark of Egocentric Robot Visual Perception of Humans in Built Environments
datasets.one: A social-navigation perception dataset recorded from a robot moving among people indoors and outdoors.
datasets.device: JackRabbot robot: 360° stereo, 2× Velodyne, 2× Sick lidar, audio
datasets.modal: 360° RGB, 3D point clouds, audio, IMU, odometry
datasets.note: The standard for robot-centric human perception. Short but exhaustively annotated.

datasets.name: R2HandoverSim
datasets.title: R2HandoverSim: A Simulation Framework and Benchmark for Robot-to-Human Object Handovers
datasets.one: The reverse direction: a simulation benchmark for robot-to-human handovers, which had no standard protocol.

datasets.name: DexH2R
datasets.title: DexH2R: A Benchmark for Dynamic Dexterous Grasping in Human-to-Robot Handover
datasets.one: Real-world human-to-robot handovers on a dexterous hand, with dense frame-level annotation.
datasets.modal: RGB-D, hand + object pose, robot state
datasets.note: The largest real handover dataset on a multi-finger hand — the physical-HRI data that barely exists elsewhere.

datasets.name: HandoverSim
datasets.title: HandoverSim: A Simulation Framework and Benchmark for Human-to-Robot Object Handovers
datasets.one: Simulation benchmark for human-to-robot handovers, driven by DexYCB human motion.
datasets.note: NVIDIA. The standard evaluation protocol for handovers, and the reason later handover work is comparable at all.

datasets.name: JRDB-Act
datasets.title: JRDB-Act: A Large-scale Dataset for Spatio-temporal Action, Social Group and Activity Detection
datasets.one: JRDB extended with spatio-temporal action, social grouping and activity labels.

datasets.name: HRIBench
datasets.title: HRIBench: Benchmarking Interaction-Centric Human-Robot Collaboration
datasets.one: Interaction-centric human-robot collaboration benchmark with role-conditioned tasks requiring synchronised multi-agent coordination.
datasets.note: Reports lifting GR00T N1.5's physical-task success from 0.10 to 0.43 using its simulated data — the most direct evidence that collaboration data is a real gap.

datasets.name: Demonstrating HumanTHOR
datasets.title: Demonstrating HumanTHOR: A Simulation Platform and Benchmark for Human-Robot Collaboration in a Shared Workspace
datasets.one: Simulation platform and benchmark for human-robot collaboration in a shared workspace, with realistic human agents.

datasets.name: Assembly101
datasets.title: Assembly101: A Large-Scale Multi-View Video Dataset for Understanding Procedural Activities
datasets.one: Multi-view procedural assembly and disassembly with both fixed and egocentric cameras and dense hand poses.
datasets.modal: RGB, multi-view, 3D hand poses, action segments
datasets.note: Both viewpoints and 18M hand poses — a good testbed for the ego-versus-exo comparison at task level.

datasets.name: HowTo100M
datasets.title: HowTo100M: Learning a Text-Video Embedding by Watching Hundred Million Narrated Video Clips
datasets.one: 136 million clips from 1.22M narrated instructional web videos — the largest source of humans explaining tasks while doing them.
datasets.note: Noisy and enormous. The natural pretraining corpus for third-person learning, if you can handle the noise.

datasets.name: The "something something" video database for learning and evaluating visual common sense
datasets.title: The "something something" video database for learning and evaluating visual common sense
datasets.one: Crowd-acted third-person clips of basic physical interactions, built to test whether models understand physical causality rather than object identity.
datasets.note: Still the sharpest test of physical rather than semantic video understanding.

datasets.name: AMASS
datasets.title: AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes
datasets.one: Fifteen optical mocap datasets unified into one SMPL body parameterisation — the backbone of humanoid motion imitation.
datasets.note: Everything from DeepMimic descendants through PHC, H2O and HOVER is trained on retargeted AMASS.

datasets.name: Learning from Massive Human Videos for Universal Humanoid Pose Control
datasets.title: Learning from Massive Human Videos for Universal Humanoid Pose Control
datasets.one: Twenty million humanoid robot poses with paired text descriptions, mined from massive human video.
datasets.note: Already retargeted to a real humanoid, which saves the step everyone else redoes.

datasets.name: Motion-X
datasets.title: Motion-X: A Large-scale 3D Expressive Whole-body Human Motion Dataset
datasets.one: Expressive whole-body motion including hands and face, annotated at frame level with text.
datasets.note: Hands and face, which AMASS lacks — relevant if your humanoid has fingers.

datasets.name: RoboVerse
datasets.title: RoboVerse: Towards a Unified Platform, Dataset and Benchmark for Scalable and Generalizable Robot Learning
datasets.one: A unified platform, dataset and benchmark that bridges many existing simulators under one interface.

datasets.name: BEHAVIOR-1K
datasets.title: BEHAVIOR-1K: A Human-Centered, Embodied AI Benchmark with 1,000 Everyday Activities and Realistic Simulation
datasets.one: A thousand everyday household activities chosen by surveying what people actually want robots to do.
datasets.note: Includes fluids, soft bodies and cloth, which almost no other benchmark simulates at all.

datasets.name: HumanoidBench
datasets.title: HumanoidBench: Simulated Humanoid Benchmark for Whole-Body Locomotion and Manipulation
datasets.one: Whole-body humanoid locomotion and manipulation tasks — and an honest finding that current RL solves the first and fails the second.

datasets.name: ManiSkill3
datasets.title: ManiSkill3: GPU Parallelized Robotics Simulation and Rendering for Generalizable Embodied AI
datasets.one: GPU-parallel physics and rendering together, for vision-based policies that need throughput on both.

datasets.name: RoboCasa
datasets.title: RoboCasa: Large-Scale Simulation of Everyday Tasks for Generalist Robots
datasets.one: Large-scale simulated household kitchens with generative scene and task variation.

datasets.name: LIBERO
datasets.title: LIBERO: Benchmarking Knowledge Transfer for Lifelong Robot Learning
datasets.one: Lifelong-learning benchmark probing knowledge transfer across task suites — the default VLA evaluation.
datasets.note: Everyone reports on it, which makes saturation weak evidence of anything real.

datasets.name: CALVIN
datasets.title: CALVIN: A Benchmark for Language-Conditioned Policy Learning for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation Tasks
datasets.one: Long-horizon language-conditioned manipulation with a strict evaluation protocol for instruction chaining.
datasets.eps: 24 h of teleoperated play per environment

datasets.name: Meta-World
datasets.title: Meta-World: A Benchmark and Evaluation for Multi-Task and Meta Reinforcement Learning
datasets.one: Fifty distinct simulated manipulation tasks for multi-task and meta-RL — the standard generalisation suite.
